stem.zh-CN: 在[[term:runtime-peak-memory|端侧推理]]过程中，以下哪项因素最可能导致实际使用的[[term:runtime-peak-memory|峰值内存]]显著超过模型文件本身的大小？
stem.en-US: During [[term:runtime-peak-memory|on-device inference]], which factor is most likely to make actual [[term:runtime-peak-memory|peak memory]] usage substantially larger than the model file itself?

explanation.en-US: Model execution also needs to retain [[term:intermediate-activation|intermediate activations]] and temporary workspaces, so [[term:runtime-peak-memory|peak memory]] can be much larger than the model file.
